exposure: Gestational age at delivery: 37 + 0 to 37 + 6 weeks

gestational age at repeat cesarean delivery
Gestational age at delivery: 38 + 0 to 38 + 6 weeks
outcome: Maternal length of stay exceeding 4 days
Neonatal length of stay exceeding 4 days

cohort: 624 women undergoing term singleton third cesarean delivery (≥ 37 weeks of gestation)
finding: Scheduling third cesarean delivery at 38 + 0 to 38 + 6 weeks of gestation was associated with reduced risk of emergent cesarean delivery and improved maternal and neonatal outcomes compared to earlier or later gestational ages at delivery.
mod_finding: Scheduling a third cesarean delivery at 38 + 0 to 38 + 6 weeks gestation is associated with a reduced risk of emergent cesarean delivery and improved maternal and neonatal outcomes compared to earlier or later deliveries.
